01AI Agents · FinTech

AgentLedger

An idempotent, x402-inspired Razorpay settlement gateway for autonomous AI agents.

Problem
Payment flows assume a human checkout and provide weak protection against duplicate agent retries.
System
HTTP 402 challenges, budget checks, signed webhooks, a deterministic state machine, and a hash-chained audit ledger.
Status
Test-mode and mock-ready buildathon implementation; explicitly not presented as live-money production.

Settlement flowIdempotent by design

Three idempotency layers protect settlement: database uniqueness, service-level guards, and webhook event deduplication. Raw-body HMAC verification protects the webhook boundary.

02Applied ML · Risk Systems

AgentShield AI

A defense-first risk and trust layer that evaluates autonomous-agent payments before money moves.

Problem
An agent can submit a technically valid payment that still violates its owner’s mandate or behavioral pattern.
System
Behavioral features, calibrated anomaly modeling, deterministic policy enforcement, and explainable ALLOW, VERIFY, or BLOCK decisions.
Evidence
The repository documents a reproducible held-out synthetic benchmark and clearly labels it as synthetic—not customer data.
PythonFastAPIMachine LearningPolicy EngineDocker
Repository ↗
Evaluation pipelineDecision before settlement
01Contextagent · merchant · velocity
→
02Risk modelbehavioral anomaly score
→
03Policydeterministic thresholds
ALLOWVERIFYBLOCK

The model contributes a risk signal; deterministic rules retain final authority. This separation keeps decisions auditable and prevents the model from directly moving money.

03Machine Learning · Explainability

Credit Risk Predictor

A reproducible ML pipeline that predicts loan approval priority while exposing a misleading data-leakage feature.

Problem
Bank and CIBIL records must be cleaned, merged, and modeled without relying on a feature unavailable in production.
System
Two clearly labeled feature sets compare the leakage-inflated model with a deployable XGBoost model aligned to the holdout schema.
Product
A Streamlit dashboard supports single and batch prediction, model comparison, SHAP explainability, and the leakage investigation.
PythonPandasXGBoostSHAPStreamlitpytest
Repository ↗Live demo ↗

→

→
MODELXGBoost
→
EXPLAINSHAP
51 featuresInflated by unavailable signal50 featuresDeployment-aligned model

The project deliberately rejects the visually impressive 99.2% leakage-inflated result and uses the lower, reproducible deployment model for predictions. The repository documents limitations rather than hiding them.
